mapper.sql: blog.id, blog.title, blog.descr, blog.tags, blog.date, blog.read_count, blog.category_id, category.name as categoryName, user.name as userName
mapper.select:
select
from blog left join category on blog.category_id = category.id left join user on blog.user_id = user.id order by blog.id desc limit #{limit}
select blog.*, category.name as categoryName, user.name as userName from blog left join category on blog.category_id = category.id left join user on blog.user_id = user.id where blog.id = #{id}

select (select count(*) from blog) as blogCount, (select ifnull(sum(read_count), 0) from blog) as totalReadCount, (select count(*) from comment where module = #{commentModule}) as commentCount, (select count(*) from user) as userCount, (select count(*) from category) as categoryCount
select category.name as name, count(blog.id) as value from category left join blog on blog.category_id = category.id group by category.id, category.name order by value desc
select id as id, name as name from category order by id
